name: Shaanxi Provincial Natural Gas Co.,Ltd
summary: Shaanxi Provincial Natural Gas Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction and operation of natural gas long-distance pipelines in China. It is involved in the planning, construction, operation, and management of the natural gas pipeline network in Shaanxi Province; transmission, distribution, and sale of downstream gas. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China. Shaanxi Provincial Natural Gas Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shaanxi Gas Group Co.,Ltd.
